courses.prerequisite_raw: No prerequisites are required for this course.
courses.course_overview_raw: In this course, you will solve problems involving simple machines, mechanical advantage, and efficiency through applying the concept of Work, Power, Torque, and Energy. Prerequisite(s): No prerequisites are required for this course.

courses.prerequisite_raw: No prerequisites are required for this course.
courses.course_overview_raw: ​In this course, you will apply principles that govern the behavior of electrical circuits and prove theories through properly using test equipment. Prerequisite(s): No prerequisites are required for this course.

courses.prerequisite_raw: No prerequisites are required for this course.
courses.course_overview_raw: ​In this course, you will learn about the concepts of magnetism and electromagnetism, and how they relate to generating electricity. You will solve problems using the principles of magnetism. You will also build an electromagnet. Prerequisite(s): No prerequisites are required for this course.

courses.prerequisite_raw: No prerequisites are required for this course.
courses.course_overview_raw: ​In this hands-on course, you will learn how to safely use both the hand and power tools that electricians need. You will gain these skills through performing basic electrical installations in a shop/jobsite environment. As well, you will learn about and follow the safety regulations at all times. Prerequisite(s): No prerequisites are required for this course.

courses.prerequisite_raw: No prerequisites are required for this course.
courses.course_overview_raw: ​In this course, you will be apply appropriate rules of the Canadian Electrical Code (CEC) toward residential wiring installations. Also, you will interpret and create electrical diagrams. Prerequisite(s): No prerequisites are required for this course.

​In this course, you will apply trigonometric functions towards vector addition and sine wave calculations. You will also use an oscilloscope to measure voltage, frequency, and relationships involved in alternating current circuits. Prerequisite(s): TELX 1154

​In this course, you will learn about the "magic" of semiconductor materials, diodes, LEDs, and transistors, find out how Silicon Valley utilized these semiconductor materials to bring us into the computer age, and solve problems involving diodes and transistors. To help you do this, you will analyze electronic components and circuits. Prerequisite(s): TELX 2131
​In this course, you will explore the function and operation of common alternating current motor starters. We will concentrate on manual and magnetic starters. Prerequisite(s): TELX 1156

courses.prerequisite_raw: No prerequisites are required for this course.
courses.course_overview_raw: ​In this course, you will learn how and where to research electrical contractors as potential employers. You will also write a resume and apply for some jobs. You may also practice interview skills. Prerequisite(s): No prerequisites are required for this course.

admission.raw: Note: This trade program is in high demand. Visit Trades Training BC to estimate a future start date. Scheduled intakes Multiple start dates each year Application processing Applications are accepted throughout the year. Consider taking this program at one of our high school locations: DW Poppy Secondary, Langley Princess Margaret Senior Secondary, Surrey Select your preferred location when you apply. A criminal record check is required to attend a high school site. Entrance requirements Applicants must meet all entrance requirements and will be accepted on a first qualified basis as long as space remains. When available intakes are full, qualified applicants are wait-listed. Applicants must meet all entrance requirements prior to applying to this program. If you are uncertain or don’t meet the requirements we strongly recommend you complete any applicable Trades Entry Assessments before applying. English language proficiency: one of: Category 3 – English Studies 12 (50%) or equivalent or BCIT English Trades Entry Assessment Math: one of the following: Pre-Calculus 11 (60%) or Foundations of Math 11 (60%) or Workplace Math 11 (60%) or Other acceptable BC and Yukon courses or BCIT Math Trades Entry Assessment Notice to applicants: This program is also offered in high school locations. Applicants who will be attending a high school site are required to undergo a criminal record check. All costs pertaining to this search are the responsibility of the applicant. Proceed with your check as soon as possible as the processing time is approximately three to four weeks. More information on the process of requesting a CRC can be found on the CRC Process [PDF] . Read more about how to meet BCIT’s entrance requirements Recommended for success Applicants should possess good health and the physical condition necessary to meet the demands of the work: good hearing, eyesight and hand/eye coordination. Potential students with medical or physical difficulties should contact Accessibility Services to arrange an interview (telephone interview if out of town) with the Institute's rehabilitation specialist: 604-451-6963. Trades Discovery The Trades Discovery General and Trades Discovery for Women are full-time programs designed to prepare participants to successfully enter and complete a Trades Training program. International applicants This program is not available to international students. View available programs . Apply to program To submit your application: Include proof of meeting all entrance requirements. Convert all transcripts and supporting documents to PDF files . Have a credit card ready to pay the application fee. Apply Now Learn more about how to apply myCommunication Within two business days of submitting your completed application, BCIT will send a message to your personal and myBCIT email addresses. All correspondence regarding your application will be posted to your online myCommunication account at my.bcit.ca . We will send you an email when a new message is posted. It is important to watch for these emails or regularly check your account online. You can expect to receive communication concerning the status of your application within four weeks.
